items.text: address change karna hai
abhi kar dijiye
new address bhej do
haan theek hai
kal tak deliver kar dena
landmark bhi change karna hai
haan bilkul

items.context: Kya aap address change karna chahte hain?
items.text: address update kar dijiye

items.context: Kab tak aap naya address provide karenge?
items.text: 15 minute mein bhej raha hu
mera order ka delivery address change karna hai abhi
please meri delivery address par naya landmark update kar dijiye
kya main apna delivery address 123 main road se badal sakta hu
mera purana address model town me tha ab naya address sector 45 hai
agar address change kar diya to kitna samay lag jayega delivery me
kya main apne phone number ke through address update kar sakta hu
mera order 56789 hai aur naya address house number 12 sector 60 hai

items.context: Aap naya address batayenge delivery ke liye?
items.text: delivery ke liye naya address send kar raha hu abhi

items.context: Aapko naya landmark batana hai kya?
items.text: naya landmark metro station ke samne hai aap update kar lena

items.context: Kya aap app me address change karke de sakte hain?
items.text: phone pe nahi change kar pa raha to app me try kar raha hu abhi

items.context: Aap address update karne ke baad kya karna chahte hain?
items.text: order cancel nahi karna bas address update kar dena jaldi se

items.context: Pichla address kya tha aur kya naya address hai?
items.text: mera previous address sector 12 tha ab change karke sector 15 karna hai
mera delivery address pehle noida sector 18 me tha lekin ab main sector 62 shift ho gaya hu
kya aap meri delivery ke address ko update kar sakte hain kyuki maine galat address diya tha initially
please mera order cancel na karein bas delivery address ko badal ke sector 23 noida se sector 44 kara dijiyega

items.context: Kya aap apna address update karna chahenge kyunki jo aapne diya hai usme kuch galti hai?
items.text: mera delivery address jo hai usme ek galti hai kya main update kar sakta hoon abhi

items.context: Aap apna delivery address change karna chahenge kya?
items.text: main apna address change karna chahta hoon kyunki main apna ghar shift kar chuka hu naye flat number 233 sector 20 mein

items.context: Kya aapko apne address me changes karwana hai?
items.text: agar main apne address me kuch correction karna chahoon toh kya aap mujhe help karenge is call pe

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: change_address - wants to change the delivery address or landmark
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with numbers (account and phone numbers, OTPs, amounts, dates) written as numerals, with long numbers spaced in groups the way people say them

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
